variable.name: Changelog
variable.value:
[B][COLOR=blue]$VAR[String_Whats_New][/COLOR][/B] [COLOR=52FFFFFF]$VAR[Changelog_WhatsNew_Date][/COLOR]
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] My Skin: Added option[/B] "[Kodi] Videos "Default select action"" (Set to "Show information" by default on first install)
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]Updated[/COLOR] Minor fixes and improvements[/B]
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]Updated[/COLOR] Wall View:[/B] Simplified focus visuals by selectively hiding labels
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]Updated[/COLOR] My Skin, Visualization & Lyrics add-on:[/B] Improved usability
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Languages & Fonts:[/B] Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Persian
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Added options[/B] "RSS feed scroll speed / font size"
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Added option[/B] "Show Chapter/EDL markers"
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]Updated[/COLOR] Sidebars:[/B] PVR sidebars rework & improved sidebars usability
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]Updated[/COLOR] Settings & "My Skin" settings:[/B] Improved usability & code clean-up
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]Updated[/COLOR] System info:[/B] Improved visuals and readability
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]Updated[/COLOR] System section:[/B] Improved usability, added add-on shortcuts
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Non-library media flags on Wall & List Views[/B]
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]Updated[/COLOR] Support for Amlogic Kodi builds[/B]
- Added CMv4 conversion & Video Processor status indicators for p3i builds (T4+)
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] All-new "Weather" section[/B]
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Library stats[/B] in "System" section (visible when focusing "Media")
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Add-on settings Rework[/B]
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Support for Game Disc Manager (Kodi 22+)[/B]
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Added option: Show pause indicator when video is paused[/B] (Default: On)
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Home: Weather Widget[/B] (Adapted. Thanks @Hitcher)
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]Updated[/COLOR] My skin settings: Add-on shortcuts Rework and more[/B]
- Reworked and simplified "Add-on shortcuts" section to a new tree-tabs layout - Replaced Cycle Buttons with native select dialogs for many settings - Reworked visuals and alignment of settings headers for better clarity
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]Updated[/COLOR] Languages[/B]
- Updated language strings to latest Confluence Kodi 22 GIT master
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]Updated[/COLOR] Performance improvements[/B]
- Further performance optimizations, code improvements and fixes, mostly targeting common Amlogic devices running CoreELEC builds - Improvements and fixes for Wall Views, preparing for new upcoming option(s) for Cinemascope Mode - Added custom Main menu focus saving and restoring functionality (Kodis native one would fail sometimes)
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Video Info Dialog: HDR type icon[/B]
- Added option for showing HDR type icon within Video Info Dialog (hdr10, hdr10plus, dolbyvision, hlg) See: My Skin – OSD, Dialogs & Views – Video Info Dialog – Show icon · HDR type
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Cinemascope Mode for projectors[/B]
- Added new feature: Cinemascope Mode for projectors - Typically used by outputting a regular 16:9 resolution while restricting the visible area and user interface to an inner 21:9 space which projects on a 21:9 projector screen without any elements being cut off - Added multiple Fullscreen Video Masking variants: 2.40, 2.35, 2.33, 2.00, 1.78 (Pseudo 16:9) - Added OSD Buttons for the new mode: Cinemascope Mode On/Off, Masking variants Cycle Toggle - See: My Skin – Advanced – Cinema – Cinemascope Mode for projectors
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Support for 21:9 displays[/B]
- Added native skin support for 21:9 display aspect ratio (3440x1440, 2580x1080 etc.): - This change removes the undesirable black bars on left/right when using a 21:9 display
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]Updated[/COLOR] Automatic Views[/B]
- Reworked "Preset Views" to "Automatic Views" including many usability improvements - Reminder: By default, Confluence ZEITGEIST automatically and always sets all views based on an preset views configuration for improved comfort and usability - See: My Skin – Advanced – "Automatic Views" - In there, you can change and configure which exact view is automatically set for different content types and situations
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Added "Picture in Picture" background "Now playing" video options[/B]
- Reworked the "Show background "Now playing" video" option - You can now choose between three options: 1) Picture in Picture (PiP) (Default) 2) Fullscreen Video 3) Disabled - Picture in Picture (PiP) is the new default - If you want to use the previous default, just select "Fullscreen Video" - See: My Skin – Background – Miscellaneous options - Show background "Now playing" video
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]Updated[/COLOR] My Skin settings Rework[/B]
- Extensively reworked and restructured My Skin settings including updated labels for improved ease of use - See: My Skin – Advanced – "Fullscreen OSD" and "Automatic Views"
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]Updated[/COLOR] Improvements for larger font size options[/B]
- CRT Mode · Huge Fonts - Accessibility · Large Fonts
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Added new Debugging option "Auto-reload skin on resolution change"[/B]
- See: My Skin – Advanced – Debugging – Auto-reload skin on resolution change (Default: Disabled)
Additional improvements, including but not limited to:
- Improved fanart handling - Added static fanart for YouTube add-on to circumvent bad and unfitting fanart situations when using the add-on - Reworked all YouTube related icons and fanart to a simplified, modern and last but not least, consistent look - Changed default background from "Frosted Glass · Light Colors" to "Frosted Glass · Sunrise" - Added new "updated to new version" dialog with an additional version changelog window - Minor code improvements
Textures:
- Added static YouTube fanart variants - Added new OSD Buttons for Cinemascope Mode feature - Updated search/youtube.png search/youtube_uhd.png - Added arrow-tree-down.png arrow-tree-right.png for My Skin settings rework - Added pip_base.png pip_border.png for "Picture in Picture" background "Now playing" video
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Support for CRT font sizes[/B]
See: Skin Settings - Reworked/new "UI font size" option; Available options: - Normal Size (Default+Recommended) - Accessibility · Large Fonts - CRT Mode · Huge Fonts
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Support for low resolutions (CRT)[/B]
- While combining "CRT Mode · Huge Fonts" with the recently introduced "Support for 4:3 and 3:2 displays", low resolutions like 720x480, 720x576 are now well supported
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Support for 16:10 displays[/B]
- Added native skin support for 16:10 display aspect ratio - This change removes the undesirable black bars on top/bottom when using a 16:10 display
[B][COLOR=FFc0392b]New[/COLOR] Support for 4:3 and 3:2 displays[/B]
- Added skin support for 4:3 and 3:2 display aspect ratios - This change removes the undesirable black bars on top/bottom when using a 4:3 or 3:2 display
